A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 21-page versions of the same KeyTailor/ViT-HD work, including Appendices A–J. Pages 2–21 have identical text and rendered content; page 1 differs only in an affiliation and the arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark results, component ablations, computational measurements, and a user study in Section 4, plus hyperparameter experiments in Appendix H.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, computational measurements, user study, and appendix hyperparameter experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendices E–G retain the same instruction-guided keyframe sampling, garment and background enhancement modules, latent fusion, LoRA adaptation, training objective, and Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both retain the same coverage of ViT-HD, ViViD/ViViD-S, VVT, VITON-HD, and DressCode, together with the same in-the-wild and person-to-video garment-transfer scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments in Tables 2–5 and the qualitative figures, including the CatV2TON and MagicTryOn comparisons in appendix Figures A1–A6.

E3.justification: The splits, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, and user-study procedures are unchanged. Section 4.1 retains 81-frame training samples, 14,500 training iterations, and 25 inference steps.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Table 6, sensitivity studies for lambda, alpha, and keyframe count in Table A1, computational analysis, and qualitative examples are identical.

E5.justification: Both retain the same point estimates and user-preference percentages. Neither reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative results are unchanged, including Tables 2–6, Table A1, and the user-study percentages. For example, Table 2 reports KeyTailor's ViT-HD SSIM of 0.9066 and LPIPS of 0.0397 in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(3) and (A1)–(A13), including the score definitions and flow-matching objective, are identical. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning keyframe-driven detail injection, computational efficiency, ViT-HD, and improved garment fidelity and background consistency.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and hyperparameter explanations are unchanged. Appendix J retains the same limitations concerning complex garment–body interactions, pretrained model capacity, and fine-grained action captioning.

D1.justification: Data-processing instructions in Section 2, implementation settings in Section 4.1, and technical details in Appendices E–G are identical. The ViT-HD dataset access link is unchanged.

R1.justification: All 47 references and the related-work discussion in Appendix A are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to GAN-based, diffusion-based, and DiT-based approaches.

P1.justification: On page 1, Xueqin Chen's affiliation changes from Sichuan University to TU Delft. The arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 24 February 2026 to v3 dated 29 April 2026. The research prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–8 and A1–A6, Tables 1–6 and A1, their captions, and their formatting and placement are identical. The front-page text updates do not restructure the page layout.

improvement.justification: v3 updates an affiliation and the version/date stamp while retaining the scientific text, methods, evidence, limitations, and visual presentation, including all appendices. These administrative edits establish no meaningful improvement or deterioration in overall paper quality.
